integrity: All finite verification results are independently reproducible with standalone Python standard-library code; the infinite result is established by the proof, not by finite computation. Scientific review is not independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Uniform available-edge greedy matching on crown graphs with n >= 2 only; no claim for vertex-first schemes or graphs with other deleted edges. The harmonic error bound is not claimed optimal. Some potentially relevant historical full texts were inaccessible and bibliographic novelty remains subject to future independent checking.
title: Sharp rare-failure law for random greedy matching on crown graphs
